limitations: Checks a conservative Markdown subset, not a full CommonMark/HTML parser.
Indented blocks, nested containers with fences, footnotes, multiline links, and raw HTML blocks are unsupported.
Blockquotes (including lazy continuation lines) are protected; ordinary quoted prose is protected only with --protect-quotes or --protect-literal.
Literal equality cannot verify facts, attribution, negation, conditions, author identity, or number-to-entity associations.
Unmarked identifiers, paths, and names require explicit --protect-literal when their exact spelling must be preserved.
Numbers are compared as a multiset of literal decimal/scientific quantities with selected currency/scale/unit spellings; no conversion is inferred.
Unlisted units, written-out numbers, decimal-comma/space-grouped notation, and reordered associations can pass; units/currencies on separate lines or in headers are not associated with values.
Protected spans are compared in source order within each category, not against surrounding prose or document structure.
A pass says only that these mechanical checks found no unauthorized changes.
